up: Return the first 200 metabolism records for the organism dog (Canis lupus familiaris, tax_id 9615). For each record, provide the substrate structure (canonical SMILES), substrate compound name (pref_name), metabolic conversion description, pathway key, and enzyme name. If the enzyme name is not available, it may be NULL. Join metabolism with compound_structures (on substrate molregno) and molecule_dictionary to retrieve the structure and name.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.pref_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.enzyme_name FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr_sub.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.tax_id = 9615 LIMIT 200
